docs.title: ChatDemo · 网页作品目录
docs.text:
把已经生成的网页组织成可打开、可交互、可部署的作品目录。

  • 本机看作品

    安装后运行 chatdemo serve，打开内置机械原型。

    进入作品说明

  • 接入自己的网页

    用 add 注册静态目录，以固定路径供浏览器访问。

    查看命令树

  • 导出完整站点

    用 export 生成画廊及所有资源，再交给静态平台发布。

    核对能力边界

  • 从 Python 调用

    直接调用目录、导出和服务函数，无需启动子进程。

    查看接口树

docs.title: 快速开始
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e .
chatdemo serve --port 8769

浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:8769/。服务默认只监听本机，按 Ctrl+C 停止。

文档栏目 内容 作品入口 已接入的交互网页与浏览方式 CLI 树 实际命令、参数和使用流程 能力地图 静态服务边界、网络默认值与部署方式 Python 接口树 可导入的目录管理和 HTTP 服务接口

网页托管能力位于 0.0.3 源码版本；从源码根目录安装。PyPI 已发布的 0.0.2 只含包发布示范模板，正式发布 0.0.3 后才能从 PyPI 获取网页命令。

docs.title: 能力地图
docs.text:
• 作品目录

    管理内置作品和显式注册的静态目录；元数据可输出为 JSON。

  • HTTP 画廊

    默认只监听本机；仅提供画廊和注册根目录里的资源。

  • 静态导出

    复制所有页面与依赖，生成适合子路径托管的完整站点。

能力 范围 三种机械原型 内置 Three.js 依赖；旋转、速度、拆解、暂停、单步 自定义网页 注册已经构建完成、以 index.html 为入口的素材目录 访问边界 禁止路径穿越、隐藏文件、符号链接和目录列表 配置 作品注册表是应用数据；无 API 密钥需求；保留 ChatEnv schema 入口 文档作品入口 文档构建时导出内置画廊，生产和预览使用相同构建规则

docs.title: 约束
docs.text:
这是面向本机与可信素材的演示服务器，不提供认证、TLS、多用户写入或后端进程。目录不得混放凭据、私密文档和未准备公开的素材。带绝对资源 URL 的自定义网页需要自行改为适合目标部署的路径；导出不重写脚本。

浏览器需要支持 WebGL 才能运行机械页。机械是可观察的视觉原型，不代表真实机械已经制造或通过物理验证。

docs.title: CLI 树
docs.text:
chatdemo
+-- --help                 # 显示帮助
+-- --version              # 输出版本
+-- --tree                 # 注册命令与参数树
+-- --tree-brief           # 简明命令树
+-- --home PATH            # 指定目录注册表位置
+-- list [--json-output]   # 列出内置和自定义作品
+-- add DIRECTORY         # 注册含 index.html 的静态目录
+-- remove SLUG           # 取消自定义作品注册，保留源文件
+-- serve                 # 启动 HTTP 画廊
+-- export DESTINATION    # 导出到空目录

docs.title: 目录管理
docs.text:
命令 必要输入 效果 list 无 列出作品；--json-output 输出结构化元数据 add DIRECTORY --slug、--title 注册公开素材目录；可加 --description remove SLUG 自定义作品标识 仅取消注册；不能移除内置作品 
chatdemo --home ./catalog add ./public --slug my-demo --title 我的作品
chatdemo --home ./catalog list --json-output
chatdemo --home ./catalog remove my-demo

slug 使用小写字母、数字和单个连字符。目录必须含 index.html，禁止隐藏素材或符号链接。必填输入缺失直接返回非零状态；注册和移除不修改源文件。服务启动时读取目录，更新目录后重启服务。

docs.title: 浏览和部署
docs.text:
命令 参数 默认行为 serve --host、--port 监听 127.0.0.1:8769；不提供账户认证 export DESTINATION 空的输出目录 完整画廊、元数据和所有静态资源 
chatdemo serve --port 8769
chatdemo export ./site-output

如需局域网访问，显式指定 --host 0.0.0.0。只注册可以公开的素材；目录下所有非隐藏静态文件可被访问。导出不会覆盖已有目录内容，使用相对链接支持站点子路径。公网发布由静态平台负责，export 不创建远端部署。

add、remove 和 export 支持 ChatStyle 的 -i/-I 交互模式。TTY 下缺失可恢复输入时自动询问；-I 或 CHATARCH_AUTO_PROMPT=0 禁用自动询问，缺失输入返回非零状态。输入从参数和交互模式进入同一套目录/标识验证。

docs.title: 作品入口
docs.text:
内置「机巧」包含六瓣星轮、双摆擒纵与行星差速，所有 Three.js 依赖随作品一起提供。

  • 在线画廊

    打开网页作品目录 →

  • 本机画廊

    执行 chatdemo serve，打开 http://127.0.0.1:8769/。

  • 自定义作品

    执行 chatdemo add 注册自己的静态页面，再重启服务。

docs.title: 机械操作
docs.text:
选择左侧模型，拖动画面旋转视角，用滑块调整速度或拆解程度，按暂停后手动推进。页面展示机械视觉设计；制造参数和真实受力需要另行验证。

返回命令树

docs.title: Python 接口树
docs.text:
chatdemo
+-- __version__
+-- cli.main                       # Click 适配层
+-- config.ChatdemoConfig          # 既有 ChatEnv schema 入口
+-- hosting.Demo                   # 作品元数据
+-- hosting.list_demos(home=None)
+-- hosting.add_demo(directory, slug, title, description="", home=None)
+-- hosting.remove_demo(slug, home=None)
+-- hosting.export_site(destination, home=None)
+-- hosting.create_server(host="127.0.0.1", port=8769, home=None)

docs.title: 可复用调用
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from chatdemo.hosting import add_demo, export_site, list_demos, create_server

home = Path("./catalog")
add_demo(Path("./public"), "my-demo", "我的作品", home=home)
for demo in list_demos(home):
    print(demo.summary())
export_site(Path("./site-output"), home=home)

server = create_server(home=home, port=8769)
try:
    server.serve_forever()
finally:
    server.server_close()

目录函数遇到不合法输入抛出 ValueError；文件与网络错误保留 OSError。Demo.summary() 不输出源目录的本机路径。CLI 是这些接口的薄适配层。ChatdemoConfig 仍注册到 ChatEnv；Web 功能不读取模板 API 密钥。

docs.title: ChatDemo · Web demonstration catalog
docs.text:
Organize generated Web artifacts into a gallery that can be explored locally and exported for static hosting.

  • Explore locally

    Run chatdemo serve to open the bundled mechanical prototypes.

    Explore demonstrations

  • Register your work

    Add a static directory and give it a stable browser path.

    Read the CLI tree

  • Export a complete site

    Export the gallery and its assets, then deploy with a static host.

    Check capabilities

  • Call from Python

    Use catalog, export and server functions without subprocesses.

    Read the API tree

docs.title: Quick start
docs.text:
python -m pip install -e .
chatdemo serve --port 8769

Open http://127.0.0.1:8769/. The default server binds to loopback; stop with Ctrl+C.

Documentation Contents Demonstrations Bundled interactive pages and browsing CLI tree Real commands, parameters and workflows Capability map Static serving boundaries and deployment Python API tree Importable catalog and HTTP functions

Web hosting is available in the 0.0.3 source version; install from its repository root. Published PyPI 0.0.2 is the release-workflow template. PyPI installation of Web commands requires the 0.0.3 release.

docs.title: Capability map
docs.text:
• Demo catalog

    Manage bundled demos and explicitly registered static roots; emit JSON metadata.

  • HTTP gallery

    Bind to loopback by default and serve only gallery and registered roots.

  • Static export

    Copy pages and dependencies into a self-contained, subpath-ready site.

Capability Scope Three mechanical prototypes Bundled Three.js; rotate, adjust speed, explode, pause and step Custom pages Already-built static directories with an index.html entry Access boundaries Reject traversal, hidden assets, symbolic links and directory listing Configuration Catalog is application data; no API key required; ChatEnv schema retained Documentation gallery Build hook exports bundled assets consistently for production and preview

docs.title: Limits
docs.text:
The server is intended for local demos and trusted assets. It does not provide authentication, TLS, multi-user writes or backend execution. Keep credentials and private documents out of registered roots. Custom pages with absolute asset paths must be adapted for their target host; export does not rewrite scripts.

Mechanical pages require WebGL. They are visual prototypes, not manufactured or physically verified machines.

docs.title: CLI tree
docs.text:
chatdemo
+-- --help                 # Show help
+-- --version              # Print version
+-- --tree                 # Registered commands and parameters
+-- --tree-brief           # Compact tree
+-- --home PATH            # Local catalog location
+-- list [--json-output]   # List bundled and registered demos
+-- add DIRECTORY         # Register a directory containing index.html
+-- remove SLUG           # Unregister a custom demo, preserving its source
+-- serve                 # Start an HTTP gallery
+-- export DESTINATION    # Export to an empty directory

docs.title: Catalog management
docs.text:
Command Required input Result list None List demos; --json-output emits structured metadata add DIRECTORY --slug, --title Register public assets; optional --description remove SLUG Custom slug Unregister only; bundled demos cannot be removed 
chatdemo --home ./catalog add ./public --slug my-demo --title "My demo"
chatdemo --home ./catalog list --json-output
chatdemo --home ./catalog remove my-demo

Slugs use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. Directories require index.html and may not contain hidden assets or symbolic links. Missing required inputs fail without prompting. Registration and removal preserve sources. Restart the server after catalog changes.

docs.title: Browsing and deployment
docs.text:
Command Options Default behavior serve --host, --port Bind 127.0.0.1:8769; no account authentication export DESTINATION Empty destination Complete gallery, metadata and static assets 
chatdemo serve --port 8769
chatdemo export ./site-output

Use --host 0.0.0.0 explicitly for LAN access. Every non-hidden file under registered roots is public. Exports refuse to overwrite existing content and use relative links for subpath hosting. A static platform owns public deployment; export creates no remote service.

add, remove and export use ChatStyle -i/-I interaction. Missing recoverable inputs prompt in a TTY. -I or CHATARCH_AUTO_PROMPT=0 disables automatic prompting and fails on missing inputs. Both paths use the same catalog validation.

docs.title: Demonstrations
docs.text:
The bundled Mechanical Atelier includes a Geneva wheel, double-pendulum escapement and planetary differential. All Three.js dependencies are included.

  • Online gallery

    Open the Web gallery →

  • Local gallery

    Run chatdemo serve and open http://127.0.0.1:8769/.

  • Custom work

    Register a static page with chatdemo add, then restart the server.

docs.title: Mechanical controls
docs.text:
Choose a model on the left, drag the scene to rotate, adjust speed or explosion sliders, and pause to advance manually. These are visual designs; fabrication dimensions and physical forces require separate validation.

Return to the CLI tree

docs.title: Python API tree
docs.text:
chatdemo
+-- __version__
+-- cli.main                       # Click adapter
+-- config.ChatdemoConfig          # Existing ChatEnv schema
+-- hosting.Demo                   # Demo metadata
+-- hosting.list_demos(home=None)
+-- hosting.add_demo(directory, slug, title, description="", home=None)
+-- hosting.remove_demo(slug, home=None)
+-- hosting.export_site(destination, home=None)
+-- hosting.create_server(host="127.0.0.1", port=8769, home=None)

docs.title: Reusable calls
docs.text:
from pathlib import Path
from chatdemo.hosting import add_demo, export_site, list_demos, create_server

home = Path("./catalog")
add_demo(Path("./public"), "my-demo", "My demo", home=home)
for demo in list_demos(home):
    print(demo.summary())
export_site(Path("./site-output"), home=home)

server = create_server(home=home, port=8769)
try:
    server.serve_forever()
finally:
    server.server_close()

Invalid catalog inputs raise ValueError; filesystem and network errors retain OSError. Demo.summary() omits local source paths. The CLI is a thin adapter. ChatdemoConfig remains registered with ChatEnv; Web features do not consume the template API key.
